text: かわいがって　やろう！

structure.jp: かわいがって　やろう！

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.span: かわいがって　やろう
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb means doing something to or for someone you look down on, and やろう makes it 'I will'. かわいがる means to treat lovingly, but here it is a threat meaning to rough someone up. かわいがって やろう = 'I'll show you a good time'.
